notes.decision: Translated as 'the outside of the All' preserving the spatial-cosmological compound. ⲥⲁⲛⲃⲁⲗ = 'side-of-outside' (cf. accumulated ⲡⲥⲁⲛⲃⲁⲗ 'the outside / outer region'). The page concludes a kephalaion mapping eight places where the living fire is set; the first place (lines 1-3) describes the foundation and members of the great earth lying outside the All.
Translated as 'the Father, the God of Truth' — standard Manichaean Father-epithet (cf. accumulated ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲧⲉ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ ⲧⲙⲏⲉ). The second of the eight ⲙⲁ where the living fire is set IS the Father himself.

'his great mighty reflection' — ⲛⲁⲟ̄ 'great' + ⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ 'reflection' (5th faculty per terminology guide) + ⲛ̄ⲭⲱⲱⲣⲉ 'mighty' (= ϫⲱⲱⲣⲉ in glossary as ⲡⲧⲭⲱⲣⲉ̄ 'the Strong One'). The Father is established in his own reflection — the introspective dwelling identified earlier as the great earth.

notes.coptic_form: ⲡⲧⲛⲁ ⲉⲧⲁⲛϩ ⲟ̄ⲁⲗⲉⲥ ⲁⲭⲙ̄ ⲡⲉϥⲥⲱⲙⲁ ϩⲓⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ
notes.decision: Translated 'the living projection mounted upon her, upon his body outside, of the Call and the Hearing.' ⲡⲧⲛⲁ = the cosmic projection (Cross of Light / Living Soul, per glossary entry). ⲟ̄ⲁⲗⲉⲥ qualitative + 3sg.f suffix 'mounted upon her' (referring to the kindled fire). The Call (ⲡⲧⲱϩⲙⲉ) and Hearing (ⲡⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ) are the two cosmic divinities of the Manichaean Call/Answer dyad — the projection IS of these. The image: the living projection of Call-and-Hearing mounted upon the cosmic body, exterior to the All.

'he left himself naked of her' — ⲁϥⲕⲁϥ 'he set him(self)' + ⲕⲁϩⲏⲩ 'naked, stripped' (= ⲕⲱ ⲁϩⲏⲩ idiom). The cosmic moment of the Living Spirit divesting itself of the living fire and standing before the Omophoros (cosmic Pillar/Atlas).

'the new land — which is the reflection.' Direct correspondential identification: the New Land of Light IS the reflection (5th faculty) at the cosmic register. Not metaphor — identification by function. The seventh fire is set in this land; the New Land herself is the first foundation/woman who crowns the whole land.

Translated 'the first woman who is a wreath' — ϣⲓⲙⲉ as Lycopolitan reflex of ⲥϩⲓⲙⲉ 'woman, wife' (loss of ⲥ-onset). The New Land of Light is identified as the feminine cosmic principle who serves as a crown/wreath (ⲕⲗⲁⲙ) for the whole land. Alternative reading 'small thing' (ϣⲏⲙ-) is contextually inferior.

'the fire that habitually manifests forth' — habitual-relative ⲉⲧⲉϣⲁ-ⲥ-ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ describes the recurring sun/moon-fire that appears from the two ships of light, giving signs of war and battle to men. This is the eighth and final fire — the visible cosmic luminaries.
'the living holy fire' — concluding-formula identifying the subject of all eight enumerations: the one Living Holy Fire that distributes itself across eight cosmic places.
